<think>API 8 removes org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandSource. The replacement for a message-receiving command initiator is typically net.kyori.adventure.audience.Audience (Sponge 8 integrates Adventure for messaging). In this file, CommandSource is only used as the type for invoker, passed to SkinApplier and to plugin.sendMessage. To adapt, replace CommandSource with Audience and update the import accordingly. This is a minimal change and aligns with Sponge 8’s messaging model. Other parts (Player, Task) may also have changes in Sponge 8, but the reported compilation errors are solely about CommandSource, so we focus on that.</think>
